info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Knowledge Asset By Param1-spec
info.description: This API enables the modification of specific knowledge assets within the intellectual property portfolio by using unique identifiers. The PATCH operation updates various attributes of a targeted knowledge asset, allowing organizations to refine and enhance their intellectual property management. Typical consumers include product managers and legal teams who require timely adjustments to asset details. This ensures that the knowledge base remains current and accurately reflects the organization's portfolio.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update the details of the specified intellectual property portfolio identified by RES-100045. Please ensure that the necessary data fields are included in the request body for a successful update.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of the intellectual property portfolio identified by RES-100045. It requires the new values for the fields that need modification.

200.description: Request completed successfully, with the updated resource returned.
